get.description:
Returns "pong" always, if the service is healthy.
This can also used for service health checks.

AttributeData.title: AttributeData
AttributeData.description:
A code list this country defines — gender, education level, crop.

Which lists exist and what they contain is country data, not platform code.
A universal superset does not exist: gender is the plain case, where
countries define genuinely different taxonomies rather than subsets of one.

AttributeValueData.title: AttributeValueData
AttributeValueData.description:
One value of a list.

Identified by `attribute_id` PLUS `value_id`: the code alone is not unique,
since 'OTHER' occurs in thirteen of Ethiopia's lists.

GeoLevelData.title: GeoLevelData
GeoLevelData.description:
A level in the hierarchy.

Depth and naming are country-specific and come from data, so consumers
must walk `parent_level_id` rather than assume any fixed set of levels.

GeoLevelValueData.title: GeoLevelValueData
GeoLevelValueData.description:
A node in the hierarchy.

`level_value_id` is the stable internal key.

attribute_id.title: Attribute Id
attribute_id.description: Code-list id. When set, returns all values for that attribute.
